content.text:
I didn't get a model accepted, and I stopped on purpose rather than fill gaps with guesses. The `web_search` tool hit its usage limit partway through. After that I couldn't retrieve market caps, Fast Retailing's EBITDA or net debt, or any of the other peers.

`submit_model` rejected my one attempt because the Inditex `market_cap` was null. I haven't found a sourced market cap for any company, and I won't type in an uncited figure.

**Sourced so far (all in millions)**

| Company | Period | Revenue | EBITDA | Net income | Net debt |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inditex (EUR) | FY2025, ended 31 Jan 2026 | 39,864 | 11,267 | 6,220 | –10,958 |
| H&M (SEK) | FY2025, ended 30 Nov 2025 | 228,285 | 39,535 | 12,085 | 156 |
| Fast Retailing (JPY) | FY2025, ended 31 Aug 2025 | 3,400,539 | not found | about 433,000 | not found |

- **Inditex:** The figures come from its FY2025 results release. EBITDA is as reported and includes the effect of IFRS 16, the lease accounting standard. Net debt is negative because Inditex reports net financial cash of 10,958.
- **H&M EBITDA:** I computed this as operating profit of 18,395 plus depreciation, amortisation and write-downs of 21,140, both from the full-year report 2025. It also includes IFRS 16 lease depreciation.
- **H&M net debt:** I computed this as 21,064 of interest-bearing liabilities excluding leases, minus 20,908 of cash. I found no short-term investments. H&M's own definition shows net cash of 233, so treat my 156 as approximate.
- **Fast Retailing:** Revenue comes from the year-end report. Net income is the rounded "¥433.0 billion" from its results presentation. I never retrieved its operating profit, D&A, debt or cash.

**Still needed**
- Market caps for Inditex, H&M and Fast Retailing.
- Fast Retailing's EBITDA (operating profit plus D&A) and net debt.
- At least one more peer, and preferably three, to reach the required 4 to 6. Candidates are Next (GBP), Gap (USD), Zalando (EUR) and Associated British Foods/Primark. Each needs revenue, EBITDA, net income and net debt sourced from filings.

With a fresh search budget I can finish the remaining peers and market caps and resubmit.
